name: Cradle of Stars
descriptionTemplate: [{Devour}: Place 1 "Sprouting Bud" with 0 Arithmetica Cost into hand and attach {Exhaust}. Inflict {Weakness} to all Enemies for 2 turns.] Obtain [Counterattack:Arg1] stacks of {Counter}. If {Death Resistance} is less than [Arg2]%, then +[Arg3]%. Dispel self {Fragile}.
lore:
Will the maiden in the cradle dream of unseen flowers?
What kind of flowers would they be? Would they, like her, be confined to a tiny pot, blooming within its limits?
Or would they, as in her younger sister's song, blossom amidst the starry skies, carried to unknown realms by cosmic dust and stardust?
